metadata.resolutionRule: Closing level of DAX (Yahoo Finance symbol ^GDAXI) on the last trading day of the week from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07, in EUR, rounded to two decimals. Read from the daily series of https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/^GDAXI?interval=1d, field indicators.quote[0].close, with the trading day derived in the exchange's own timezone. If 2026-08-07 is a market holiday, the last trading day of that same week counts. If no close is published for that week, the event is voided and scores nothing for anyone.
